title: Create-team permission without view-team permission breaks Teams page
description: When create team is allowed and view team is not, the user cannot create a team and the Teams page returns a 500.

title: Planner with view+edit configuration cannot edit configs
description: A planner allowed to view and edit configurations gets an error when editing the configs.

title: Counter-offer time shown in IST regardless of client time zone
description: Time zone in counter offer was shown in IST.

title: MQCS not triggered after vendor places a bid
description: The MQCS is not being triggered even after the vendor placed a bid.

title: Summary-view template ignores updated prefix/suffix
description: The template for the summary view of material+service intakes does not pick up the latest prefix/suffix updated in the database.

title: Vendor profile redirects to Home page
description: Clicking a vendor profile redirects to the Home page instead of opening the vendor details page.

title: Bulk upload sheet visible across all entity accounts
description: A bulk upload sheet uploaded in one account is visible in all other accounts; entity data isolation is not maintained.

title: Cannot create PO: Quick Fill leaves required fields empty
description: Purchase Order cannot be created because Quick Fill does not populate the required fields.

title: Rejected vendors still listed in MQCS
description: Vendors whose bids were rejected still appear in the MQCS list.

title: Awarding fails: proposal add_response call errors
description: Vendor awarding does not work; the MQCS awarding call POST /api/proposal/<id>/add_response fails.

title: RFQ page does not open after vendors place bids
description: The RFQ page fails to open once vendors have placed bids.

title: Cannot start vendor onboarding: Purchase Group dropdown empty
description: Vendor Onboarding → Start Onboarding shows an empty Purchase Group dropdown, so onboarding cannot start.

title: Onboarding event missing from Events tab
description: The onboarding event is not shown in the event tab.

title: Invite Vendor option missing during BOQ event creation
description: The Invite Vendor option is not visible while creating a BOQ event, so vendors cannot be added at creation.

title: Not all vendors listed in Participants when updating audience
description: Some eligible vendors are missing from the Participants tab while updating the audience.

title: Create PO fails on events with many line items
description: Create PO API fails intermittently on large line-item events.

title: Submit PO call fails
description: Submit PO call fails.

title: Event group load takes 17.6 s with 937 line items
description: GET /api/event_groups/<id> responded in 17.58 s for a 937-line-item BOQ event.

title: Bid product creation takes 15 s on large events
description: POST /api/v1/bids/<id>/create_bid_products took 15.3 s for 937 line items.

title: Convert to auction returns 503 on large events
description: POST /api/trade/move_to_auction returned 503 for a 937-line-item event.

title: Bid submit intermittently returns 503
description: While submitting a bid the vendor intermittently gets a 503.

title: Surrogate bid template input takes 60 s
description: POST /api/bids/template_input took 59.71 s on a 600-line-item event.

title: Reject bid takes 32 s
description: PATCH /api/bids/<id>/reject took 32 s on a 600-line-item event.

title: Master QCS blank after bid placement on BOQ event
description: Master QCS is blank even after bid placement.

title: Counter offer on BOQ bid truncates value and is very slow
description: Counter offer does not accept the complete value and is very slow.

title: Technical stage data lost when moving to RFQ stage
description: Creating an event and moving from technical to RFQ loses the technical stage's data; it must be filled again.

title: Updating planner logs the buyer out with 401
description: On event rfx-1325, updating the planner logged the buyer out and returned 401 Unauthorized.

title: Vendor cannot see own bid when bid masking is on
description: With bid masking on, the vendor's placed bid vanishes from their view.

title: Bid masking switches off when a draft is republished
description: Saving an event as draft with bid masking on and publishing it later turns bid masking off.

title: Updating one evaluator updates all sections in vendor-wise evaluation
description: In vendor-wise evaluation, updating a planner updates the evaluators of all sections instead of the individual one.
